full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media portrait shows a young woman looking directly outward, her face interwoven with faded technical drawings and paper textures. The crop is very close: her forehead reaches the top edge, her chin nears the lower edge, and dark brown hair closes around both sides. The background is mostly hidden behind the head, though narrow strips of old cream paper remain visible along the right and upper left. Her hazel-green eyes form the strongest points of focus in the upper half, their dark pupils and small catches of light rendered with unusual precision. Fine freckles and warm rose shadows appear beneath the eyes and around the bridge of the nose. The nose is softly modeled in peach and umber, while the closed lips are a muted coral color with a narrow highlight. Hair sweeps diagonally across the upper right and falls in deeper shadow beside the cheeks. At the upper left, a partial circular diagram overlaps the brow, its thin compass-like rings and tiny marks too small to read. Rectangular grids, transparent blocks, and faint vertical measuring lines cross the lower left of the face and shoulder. More narrow red and gray diagram lines run along the right paper strip. These translucent marks do not hide the underlying face; their worn edges make them appear embedded in the same aged surface. Soft frontal light reveals the skin and keeps the eyes clear, with slightly warmer brightness on the left cheek and deeper shadow around the hairline. Fine pencil-like contours, smooth painted flesh, scratched paper grain, and lightly stained areas coexist without a single uniform texture. The overall composition is intimate and layered, using a warm human face against cool faded diagrams to create a thoughtful, archival mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介肖像呈现一名直视画外的年轻女子，脸部与褪色技术图纸及纸张肌理相互交织。画面裁切得很近：额头抵达上缘，下巴靠近下缘，深棕头发从两侧合拢。背景大多被头部遮住，但右边和左上方仍留有旧奶油色纸张的窄边。榛绿色双眼是上半部最强的焦点，深瞳孔和细小眼中亮点被异常精确地绘出。细雀斑和暖玫瑰色阴影出现在眼下及鼻梁周围。鼻子以桃色与棕色柔和塑形，闭合嘴唇呈暗珊瑚色，留有一道细亮光。头发从右上方斜扫而下，在双颊旁落入更深阴影。左上方，一段圆形图样覆盖额头，细窄、近似圆规画出的同心线和小标记细到无法辨字。矩形网格、半透明方块和浅淡竖向刻度线横过脸部及肩膀的左下侧。右边纸条上还有细窄的红灰色图纸线。这些半透明痕迹没有遮住下面的脸；磨旧边缘使其看似嵌在同一陈年表面。柔和正面光显出皮肤，使双眼保持清楚，左脸颊稍暖稍亮，发际周围阴影更深。细铅笔般轮廓、平顺绘出的肌肤、刮擦纸纹和轻微染色区域共存，没有单一均匀肌理。整体构图亲密而层叠，以温暖的人脸对照冷淡褪色的图纸，形成沉思的档案感。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media image joins finely modeled warm color with translucent geometric overlays on a worn cream ground. Precise local contours and small sharp focal details contrast with soft blended tonal areas. Thin circles, grids, and measuring-like lines float across the surface at varied opacity, suggesting an archival diagram without becoming fully readable text. Paper grain, scratches, stains, and ghosted rectangles break the smooth painted passages into layered depth. Warm peach, muted coral, and brown are balanced by cool sage, gray, and pale blue-green; the colors remain subdued rather than highly saturated. Frontal diffused light brings the central form forward, while darker edges and transparent marks keep the periphery busy but quiet. The overall effect is intimate, thoughtful, and timeworn, with human warmth held inside an ordered field of aged graphic traces.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅混合媒介图像把细致塑形的暖色与磨旧奶油色底上的半透明几何叠层接合。精确的局部轮廓和小面积锐利焦点细节，与柔和融合的明度区域形成对照。细圆环、网格和近似刻度的线条以不同透明度漂浮在表面，暗示档案图纸，却不变成完全可读的文字。纸张颗粒、刮痕、污迹和幽灵般的矩形把平顺绘画区域打断为层层深度。暖桃色、暗珊瑚色与棕色由冷鼠尾草绿、灰色及浅蓝绿平衡；颜色保持克制，而非高度饱和。正面漫射光使中央形体前凸，较深的边缘和透明痕迹让周缘繁复但安静。整体效果亲密、沉思而充满岁月痕迹，人的温度被包在有秩序的陈旧图形痕迹之中。
theme_en: A close portrait of a young woman overlaid with faded technical drawings
theme_zh: 叠有褪色技术图纸的年轻女子面部特写
name: Michael Shapcott
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
